text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out and about with Machikane 
Tannhauser—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Bourbon-san and Rice-san. Hello~!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hello, Tannhauser-san.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
H-Hello... What a coincidence. Are you two 
out together?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes, taking a breather is important too~. 
Are you two heading out as well?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... Bourbon-san asked me to go to 
Bubbly Land with her. She brought 
invitation tickets."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission 1: "Win the Sweepstakes" — 
Success. Mission 2: "Invite Rice-san to 
Bubbly Land" — In progress.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you... for being so kind to Rice.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Confirmed expression of 'gratitude' from 
Rice Shower. Searching for appropriate 
response............ You are welcome.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...! See you later then, 
Tannhauser-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you two get along so well. That's 
so nice, it looks like fun~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's go to Bubbly Land too! After 
all, we're great friends!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yay! Well then, off to Bubbly Land we go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wah, it's so lively~. And yet, here I am—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I forgot my swimsuit~! 
Ugh... My bubbly summer~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much not just for the 
swimsuit, but for the fluffy fan too~♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Woohoo♪ Bubbly is simply the best~♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's almost parade time, huh... I really, 
really wanna see it... but... I danced so 
much I'm getting sleepy~...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mnh-mnh... *snore*~~
choice_data_list: Let's get the parade on video.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... We finally made it! 
This waterslide sure is tall~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
After all that hard work, I'm gonna enjoy 
mysel— Wait, my nose feels itchy...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I-I might get a nosebleed!?
choice_data_list: Let's get off and take a break!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The lively time spent with Machikane 
Tannhauser flew by in the blink of an 
eye...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Man, Bubbly Land really is a blast, isn't 
it? I'm so glad I came~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? Aren't those two over there...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Searching... Searching... Approaching Rice 
confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry to keep you waiting...! Um, you 
see, well—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: If it's not too much trouble... here.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Body temperature and heart rate rising due 
to an unexpected event. ...To tell the 
truth, I had bought a drink for Rice-san 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you too, Bourbon-san? For someone 
like Rice... T-Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am glad to see you pleased. ...Mission 
accomplished.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... Rice too. ...Fufu, we're the 
same."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
They're showing so much care for one 
another... Such nice mutual respect~, 
mm-hmm.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I should follow their example and make 
sure I don't forget to be considerate—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? But wait, aren't I always depending 
on Trainer for everything... !?
choice_data_list: You don't need to worry about it.

I want you to answer with your results on 
the track!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Of course I care~! These things are all 
about give and take!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna go buy some tasty 
food too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! It's so crowded... I-I'm getting 
swept away~~?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah~~n! Where are you even heading~~!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After rescuing Matikanetannhauser, both of 
us were completely exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes, leave it to me! I'm gonna win tons 
and tons~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Umm, so if I up the quality of my 
training... How do I do that?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! What kind of race should we run then? 
We also need to consider the schedule... 
Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, then you're gonna end up taking 
care of me the whole time again~~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser racked her brains, 
wondering how she could ever return the 
favor...
